eps.ov: Ungrateful for his contributions, Lent's adventuring party cruelly kicks him out for being a burden.
Lent's gift fairy explains the features of his newly evolved gift, Infinite Magic Storage.
Lent travels to Melva to build up his strength by slaying monsters.
Lent explores the Melva Labyrinth with Empee while the Skypiercers desperately search for him.
Linka is abandoned by her party, and Lent takes on the powerful Quad Skeleton in order to save her.
The Skypiercers struggle against weak enemies, while Lent and Linka fight for the first time together.
Lent and Meteor Shower catch up over drinks and asks them for a favor.
Lent takes on the Skypiercers three against one in a duel.
